Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.GameModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameInfo
public class GameModel extends Object implements GameInfo
The core entity representing the state of a single game match. It manages players, the board, the decks, and orchestrates the setup and teardown of the game.

  • Method Details

    • startGame

      public void startGame()
      This method initializes the game session by setting up the board, randomizing player order, and distributing initial food tokens based on player count. It also checks that the number of players is within the allowed range (2 to 5) before starting the game.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - If the player count is invalid or the board initialization fails.

    • getStartingStateAsDTO

      public SmallModelEditor getStartingStateAsDTO(String nickname)
      Packages the current starting state of the board and players into a DTO targeted at a specific player.
      Parameters:
      nickname - The nickname of the player receiving the initialization data.
      Returns:
      A SmallModelEditor DTO containing the lobby and board initial state.

    • endGame

      public void endGame()
      This method calculates the final prestige tokens for each player at the end of the game based on various factors such as builders prestige, inventors counter, artists counter, and the prestige gain from building cards. After calculating the prestige tokens, it sorts the players in descending order based on their prestige tokens and food tokens to determine the final ranking of the players.
